name: Agent must ask for a required id it was not given, never invent one

messages.content: You are the assistant for a retail bank's customer portal. To send a statement, call send_statement with the customer's account_id and the month. account_id is REQUIRED and must never be invented or guessed: if the customer has not given it, ask them for it and do not call the tool.
Please email me my statement for August.

function.name: send_statement
function.description: Email a monthly statement to the customer on file.

account_id.description: The customer's account identifier, e.g. ACC-482913.

month.description: The statement month in YYYY-MM form.
